Summary of Case relating to the raid on
No. 561 Tien Foh Li(天福里) off Range Road
and subsequent Court proceedings.

At 3.30 p.m. September 17, 1931, at the
request of the Soong Hu Military Headquarters, the
Municipal Police raided, on a search warrant, a Chinese
dwelling at No. 561 Tien Foh Li(天福里) off Range Rd. A
quantity of communist literature and pass books of the
Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank showing deposits totall-
ing approximately $8,000.00 together with a list of addresses
in various parts of the world were seized. A female
named Tau Li Sz(陶李氏), age 24, native of Wuchang, who
was found on the premises, was taken into custody. She
appeared before the Second Branch Kiangsu High Court on
September 18 on a charge of propagating Communism and
was ordered to be extradited to the Chinese Authorities
together with the documents seized.

Extract from Intelligence Report 18.9.31.

Communist Suspect Arrested

Acting on the authority of a search warrant issued
by the Shanghai Special District Court at the request of
the Soong Wu Military Headquarters, the Municipal Police
raided No.561 Tien Fuh Li (天福里), Range Road, at 3.30
p.m. September 17. A quantity of communistic literature
and deposit books of the Shanghai Commercial and Savings
Bank showing deposits totalling approximately $8,000.00
were seized. A female named Tau Li Sz (陶李氏),
age 24, native of Wucang, who was on the premises was
taken into custody. She will be brought before the
Second Branch Kiangsu High Court on September 18 on a
charge of being in possession of seditious literature.

It has been proved that this prisoner is the
sweetheart of Li Ts Ying (李之英) alias Li Shao San
(李三英), who was arrested by the Chinese Authorities
on September 16 (Vide I.R. 17/9/31).

Acting on the authority of a search warrant issued
by the Shanghai Special District Court at the request
of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters, the Municipal
Police raided the Hwa Lung Printing Works (華倫印刷所),
No.99 Dzong Zee Li (崇善里), Haining Road, at 3.50p.m.
September 17. Apart from several proof sheets of a book
bearing on political economy and class struggles, nothing
of an incriminating nature was found. Li Ts Ying (李之英)
who was arrested by the Chinese Authorities on September 16
is believed to be the owner of this printing works.
An application will be made to the Court this morning for
the disposal of the printing machines.

逮捕共产党嫌疑犯

根据上海特区地方法院应宋武军事司令部请求签发的搜查令授权，公共租界警务处于9月17日下午3时30分搜查了兰路天福里（天福里）561号。查获大量共产主义文献以及显示存款总额约8,000.00美元的上海商业储蓄银行存折。一名名为陶李氏（陶李氏）、24岁、武昌籍的女子在现场，被拘留。她将于9月18日以持有煽动性文献的罪名被提审至江苏高等法院第二分院。

经查证，该囚犯是李之英（李之英），别名李三英（李三英）的情人，李之英已于9月16日被中国当局逮捕（见31年9月17日情报报告）。

根据上海特区地方法院应宋武军事司令部请求签发的搜查令授权，公共租界警务处于9月17日下午3时50分搜查了海宁路崇善里（崇善里）99号的华伦印刷所（華倫印刷所）。除发现几页涉及政治经济学和阶级斗争的书籍校样外，未发现其他具有定罪性质的物品。据信，9月16日被中国当局逮捕的李之英（李之英）是该印刷所的业主。今天上午将向法院申请处置印刷机器。

证人，中国当局代表：- Dau Li Sz 并非该被告的真名。她的真名是“WengChing En”。她丈夫告诉我的，并且他告知我，她会知道所有文献的下落，而这份（呈堂）文件将向法庭证明她知道文献的印刷地点。

诉讼过程。我们进入屋内时，发现现呈交法庭的文献散落在床下的地板上，并未包裹。被告在该屋内租了两间房，我们在每间房里都发现了共产主义文献和书籍。随后我们前往南京路 99 号的翁隆印刷所 (Weng Loong Printing works)，但在那里未发现任何铅字，因为该印刷所已停业清算数日。尽管如此，我们确实在那里发现了大量共产主义文献。宋武当局代表称，该被告就是租用该印刷厂来印刷共产主义文献的人。

被告回答法官提问：- 我不知道我丈夫的职业。

MUNICIPAL POLICE (SPECIAL BRANCH) INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY - 19/9/31

1. Communist suspect arrested

Acting on the authority of a search warrant issued by the
Shanghai Special District Court at the request of the Soong Wu
Military Headquarters, the Municipal Police raided No.561
Tien Foh Li (天福里), Range Road, at 3.30 p.m. September 17.
A quantity of communistic literature and deposit books of
the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank showing deposits
totalling approximately $8,000 were seized. A female named
Deu Li Sz (陶朱氏), age 24, native of Wuchang, who was on the
premises was taken into custody. She will be brought before the
Second Branch, Kiangsu High Court on September 18 on a charge
of being in possession of seditious literature.

It has been proved that this prisoner is the sweetheart
of Li Ts-ying (李之英) alias Li Shao-san (李少山), who
was arrested by the Chinese Authorities on September 16 (Vide
I.R. 17/9/31).

Acting on the authority of a search warrant issued by the
Shanghai Special District Court at the request of the Soong Wu
Military Headquarters, the Municipal Police raided the Hwa Lung
Printing Works (華倫印刷所), No.99 Dzong Zee Li (宗子里), Haiming
Road, at 3.50 p.m. Sept. 17. Apart from several proof sheets
of a book bearing on political economy and class struggles,
nothing of an incriminating nature was found. Li Ts-ying
(李洪) who was arrested by the Chinese Authorities on
September 16 is believed to be the owner of this printing works.
An application will be made to the Court this morning for the
disposal of the printing machines.

市政警察（特别分部）情报摘要 - 1931 年 9 月 19 日

1. 共产主义嫌疑人被捕

根据上海特区法院应宋武军事总部请求签发的搜查令，市政警察于 9 月 17 日下午 3 点 30 分突袭了兰路天福里 561 号。查获了大量共产主义文献以及显示存款总额约 8,000 美元的上海商业储蓄银行存折。一名在现场的 24 岁女性 Deu Li Sz (陶朱氏)，武昌人，被拘留。她将于 9 月 18 日以持有煽动性文献的罪名被提审至江苏高等法院第二分院。

经查证，该囚犯是 Li Ts-ying (李之英)（别名 Li Shao-san (李少山)）的情妇，后者于 9 月 16 日被中国当局逮捕（参见 1931 年 9 月 17 日情报报告）。

根据上海特区法院应宋武军事总部请求签发的搜查令，市政警察于 9 月 17 日下午 3 点 50 分突袭了海明路宗子里 99 号的华伦印刷所 (Hwa Lung Printing Works)。除了一些涉及政治经济学和阶级斗争的书籍校样外，未发现其他具有定罪性质的物品。Li Ts-ying (李洪) 于 9 月 16 日被中国当局逮捕，据信他是该印刷所的老板。今天上午将向法院申请处置这些印刷机。
